title: Hemoglobin–bicarbonate coupling and grip strength: a negative incremental prediction test across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A hemoglobin-by-bicarbonate product did not meet the registered incremental grip-prediction criterion: source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.365817, second-cycle gain -0.046199 kg² (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-1.851413,0.960988]). This does not establish absence of physiological interaction. Source n=1847; target n=2095. Target baseline/augmented MSE=123.249842/123.296040 kg². The cycles were separately sampled but reused in earlier projects; no untouched independent-cohort validation was completed.
